summary: Sampling randomness is not the supported quality control for the synchronized GPT reasoning models and non-default values are incompatible with reasoning execution. Lixpi omits it and exposes effort, mode where supported, and answer verbosity instead.
combines: Supported on: gpt-4o, gpt-4.1 and other non-reasoning models. REJECTED with a 400 `Unsupported parameter` / "not supported with this model" on o-series (o1, o1-mini, o3, o3-mini, o4-mini) and on gpt-5 family reasoning models. Reported exception: `gpt-5.1` accepts it when `reasoning.effort` is `none`. `gpt-5-chat-latest` / `gpt-5.x-chat-latest` are non-reasoning chat models and accept it.
On reasoning models the intended substitute is `reasoning.effort` plus `text.verbosity`; there is no temperature equivalent.
The safe pattern is a per-model capability flag that omits the field entirely rather than sending `1`.
note: Not sent by current GPT reasoning model profiles. Use reasoning effort and prompting.
